tools.name: design_memory_audit
tools.description: Runs the net-new-only design drift audit against the synced reference snapshot for the repository. Blocks only new or reopened drift (baseline + review memory applied). Exit codes: 0 = clean, 1 = drift found, 2 = no reference snapshot (run sync-reference first). For the agent loop use the CLI directly: `design-memory audit --json` emits the full AuditRun document (issues with line/col and suggested fixes, warnings) as the only stdout content.
